note: Cleans up the catalogue entries these two makes carried alongside the fabricated OilFinderVehicle rows. Geely's whole range sat on '5W-40 Universal High-Performance'. SsangYong's sat on '15W-40 MB Sheet 229.1' with every engine recorded as petrol — including the D20DT/D20DTR/D20DTF e-XDi diesels, which run a particulate filter and need a low-SAPS 5W-30, and the OM662 that the catalogue calls '2.9 Essence'. The Mercedes-derived petrols genuinely do take an MB-sheet oil, so those keep it. Capacities are family figures unless stated otherwise.

engines.source: SsangYong's own e-XDi common-rail diesels — D16DTF/D16DTR 1.6, D20DT/D20DTF/D20DTR 2.0, D27DT 2.7 (Tivoli, Korando, Actyon, Rexton, Kyron). Recorded as petrol on a 15W-40 MB sheet, which is neither the right fuel nor a grade their particulate filter tolerates. Capacity is a family figure.

The Mercedes OM601/OM602/OM662 indirect-injection diesels SsangYong built under licence (Musso, Korando, Istana), which the catalogue lists as '2.9 Essence'. Pre-common-rail and no particulate filter, so a conventional 15W-40 is correct and suits hot climates.

SsangYong's own G16DF 1.6 e-XGi and G15TF 1.5 T-GDi (Tivoli, Korando, XLV). AUTODOC and autopartspro give the Tivoli 1.6 petrol a 4.0 L fill on 5W-30 meeting ACEA C3. These are modern direct-injection units, not the licensed Mercedes petrols that keep an MB sheet.

The Mercedes M104, M111 and M161 petrol engines SsangYong built under licence, and their G/E-series derivatives (Musso, Korando, Rexton, Chairman). An MB-sheet oil is genuinely correct for these; only the grade and the sump figure are family-derived.
mymotorlist.com Geely JLD-4G20: 5W-30, 4.5 L (Atlas, Emgrand X7, Emgrand 8). Also covers the catalogue's descriptive '2.0 (JL486ZQ)' entry for the same engine.
mymotorlist.com Geely JLY-4G15: 5W-30, 4.0 L (Emgrand EC7, Emgrand 7). Also covers the catalogue's descriptive '1.5 (JLy-4G15B)' entry for the same engine.
Geely MR479Q / MR479QA 1.5 and MR481QA 1.8 — the Mitsubishi 4G18-derived units in the CK, MK and Emgrand. Capacity is a family figure.
Geely JL376QE 1.0 and JL378QE 1.3 (Panda, LC, CK). Small sump; capacity is a family estimate.
Genuine Toyota 5A-FE and 8A-FE units, which Geely licensed for its early cars. Same figures the Toyota table gives them.
